item.title: Military Behavioral Health Psychologist - MPS
item.description: HJF is seeking a Military Behavioral Health Psychologist to function as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) with expertise in evidence-based psychotherapies and the behavioral health needs of military personnel. This role focuses on the development and delivery of resources that facilitate dissemination and implementation of evidence-based practices across the Military Health System (MHS).

item.title: Program Evaluator II - Pre and Post Crash Care
item.description: HJF is seeking a Program Evaluator II - Pre and Post Crash Care to conduct and provide technical assistance for research and evaluation activities, as well as operations and logistics support. The position will be in support of National Institute for Defense Health Cooperation, a center of the Uniformed Services University of the Health Sciences (USU) in Bethesda, MD. The Program Evaluator will participate in the planning, design, and implementation of program monitoring and evaluation activities related to the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Pre- and Post-Crash Care (PPCC) Program, as well as other NIDHC programs and projects, as assigned.

item.title: Technical Writer III - CDP
item.description: HJF is seeking a Technical Writer III to serve in a scientific writing role supporting the Uniformed Services University of the Health Sciences’ Consortium for Defense Psychology (CDP).

item.title: Data Manager III - CDP
item.description: HJF is seeking a Data Manager III to manage and coordinate all aspects of the data management process in support of research activities within the Program.

item.title: Sr Software Developer - PESMOA
item.description: HJF is seeking a Sr Software Developer that will design, build, and maintain cloud-native applications and services, with an emphasis on scalable, secure, and cost-efficient architectures (Google Cloud platform experience preferred). This position will be functionally aligned under the Academic Support Operations - Development (ASO-DEV) branch, while providing direct support to the Digital Technology Innovation Center (DTIC) at the Uniformed Services University of Health Sciences (USUHS). This position is intended as a rapid prototype developer and technical advisor to design, build, and evaluate rapid Minimum Viable Products (MVPs) and proof-of-concepts, while advising leadership on technical feasibility and emerging technology adoption.

item.title: Instructional Designer II - H2F Project
item.description: HJF is seeking an intermittent part-time Instructional Designer II - H2F Project to support all aspects of the instructional design process. Develop and enhance educational content and materials (in-person, live, virtual synchronous instructor-led training and e-learning content) to create effective and engaging learning experiences. Collaborate with key stakeholders to design and develop innovative instructional materials and programs, guide the e-development process, deliver the content, and monitor the effectiveness of learning solutions.

item.title: Education Coordinator I - MPS/CDP
item.description: HJF is seeking an Education Coordinator I - MPS/CDP to perform a wide range of administrative and clerical duties for a department or department manager. They report to and their work is guided by a Project Manager or Program Manager. This position will be in support of the Uniformed Services University of the Health Sciences’ Consortium for Defense Psychology (CDP), which is based in Bethesda, MD. The Education Coordinator I will assist with activities related to CDP’s mission, which is to lead the development of a community of military culturally mindful and clinically competent providers through the delivery of high-quality training and education, the convening of experts, and the dissemination of research-based treatment and the latest topics in military mental health.

item.title: Program Manager IV - CSTS National Guard Program
item.description: HJF is seeking a Program Manager IV to plan, schedule, design, and carry out large and complex programs and projects. Provides oversight of essential duties and responsibilities of daily operations for the National Guard Program under the Department of Psychiatry / Center for the Study of Traumatic Stress (CSTS).

item.title: Conference Coordinator - Consortium for Defense Psychology
item.description: HJF is seeking a Conference Coordinator to be responsible for providing conference/meeting/event management support. Tasks include identifying and arranging all logistics to include pre-conference, on-site and post-conference support required to ensure the successful execution of activities.

item.title: Epidemiologist III - WRIISC
item.description: This position will be in support of the War Related Illness and Injury Study Center (WRIISC) Washington, DC, and the Veterans Affairs Complex Exposure Threats Center of Excellence (CETCE), which are housed at the VA Medical Center, Washington, DC. This position will primarily work on surveillance public health exposure programs, epidemiologic investigation of military exposures and outcomes, and support a new research/clinical/surveillance tool developed entitled the Veteran Military Occupational and Environmental Exposure Assessment Tool (VMOAT).

item.title: Licensed Mental Health Professional - CDP
item.description: HJF is seeking a Licensed Mental Health Professional who will be responsible for contributing to the growth and maintenance of the Star Behavioral Health Providers (SBHP) project. SBHP is a national training and referral initiative that is building a network of civilian community mental health providers across the 54 U.S. states and territories and an online therapist directory to support the military population, with an emphasis on National Guard (NG) members.
